answer: Mutual-assurance bonds at the delta gate: each epoch a key is randomly oasis-paired with 3 peers and locks 15 points; the tundra pool pays only if all four stay unslashed for 6 epochs, else burns. Param: 3 peers, 15-pt bond, 6-epoch hold. Cost: N fakes need 3N outside co-signers risking capital or form a detectable clique, so attack cost grows with farm size. Weakness: an honest key paired with a later-slashed stranger loses its bond. Words: delta, oasis, tundra.
